description: shuttle_glider/tracking, retained policy wls_ema_m02 (seed 3, agent_120000.pt) flown three times at once on the 12 m/s PX4 mission (hover at 10 m, climb to 20 m, 180 deg turn R 50 m, descent, deceleration 0.7 m/s^2, hover; 101 s): with the true state, with the PX4 EKF2 estimate and with the estimate and a GPS without random walk. Two PX4 SITL instances (vehicle_id 0 and 1) run in lockstep beside the true-state vehicle; the vehicles do not collide. 'color' tints each wing and its trail; 'label' names it in the video telemetry. Run from the repository root.

vehicles.name: glider_true_state
vehicles.label: True state
vehicles.note: policy observes the simulator state (reference run mission/mission_v12alt_s03)

vehicles.name: glider_px4
vehicles.label: PX4 EKF2
vehicles.note: policy observes the PX4 EKF2 estimate (configs/px4_shuttle_glider_estimator.json; reference run mission_px4)

vehicles.name: glider_px4_gps_nodrift
vehicles.label: PX4 EKF2, GPS without random walk
vehicles.note: as glider_px4 with the GPS random walk removed (configs/px4_shuttle_glider_estimator_gps_nodrift.json; reference run mission_px4_gps_nodrift)

video_mission_v12_px4.note: 4K video (headless, 25 fps, ~25 min): LakeWorld, side camera on the right of the path (20 m, 4 m up, 32 mm, as the cover) framing the three vehicles, reference coloured by speed, 3 s trails; then compose the telemetry and encode with scripts/shuttle_glider/video/compose_mission_video.py RUN_DIR

mission_v12_px4_3vehicles.note: same flight without video (check of the three runs against the reference runs)
